title: Two Coats
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Many people came to the river to be baptized by John. He said, “Show that you have really changed.” A good tree shows it is good by its fruit.
The people asked John, “Then what should we do?” He said, “Two coats? Give one to someone who has none. Share your food, too.”
Tax collectors came too. They gathered money for the rulers, and some took extra for themselves. John said, “Take only what is fair.”
p2: Soldiers asked, “And what should we do?” John said, “Do not hurt anyone or tell lies about them. Be happy with your pay.”
A changed heart shows in kind hands. Tonight, think of one thing you can share tomorrow.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
